recommendations.description: Prioritize a CA HMO acute hospital provider-specific claims-processing review at UCI MEDICAL CENTER for inpatient Med/Surg and OB claims tied to digestive disorders, degenerative nervous system disorders, and vaginal delivery with CC to confirm contractual processing and isolate diagnosis-specific drivers, then complete the same focused PPO review at OLYMPIC MEDICAL HOSPITAL.
evidence: CA HMO acute hospital added about $506K total.
Digestive disorders at UCI MEDICAL CENTER added about $239K on more HMO claims.
